## Checklist before merging

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Chinese or English descriptions are welcome.

- [ ] Your code builds clean without any errors or warnings
- [ ] Your code follows [LeviLamina C++ Style Guide](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina/wiki/CPP-Style-Guide)
- [ ] You have run the storage, generation and export tests
- [ ] You have described in-game validation for changes to hooks or capture behavior
- [ ] You have updated both READMEs when user-facing behavior changes
- [ ] You have not used code without license
- [ ] You have added statement for third-party code
